name: Gawain
subtitle: The Stalwart
description: Protect the knights of Avalon whilst passing the Green Knights Trials.
lore: One of the most loyal Knights of the Round Table in the old world, Gawain’s fealty has reached the heights of zealotry in the new. His devotion to Arthur is a religious fervor, and though it is not his first choice, he will take all manner of dishonorable and vicious actions in its defense, even at the cost of his own reputation.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when this hero receives a [Disable]

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Honor and Chivalry
Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Noon's Might
skills.description: Attack all enemies (180%DEF+130%ATK) with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:atk-down-ii] for 2 turns. Also place [mechanic:shield]200% DEF on all allies

skills.name: Courageous Devotion
skills.description: When an ally receives a [Disable], there is a 40% chance this hero will receive it instead.
skills.awakening_bonus: At the start of this hero’s turn, remove all [Disable].

skills.name: Honor and Chivalry
skills.description: Place [mechanic:def-up-ii] on this hero for 2 turns then place [mechanic:protect-ii] on all allies for 2 turns except this hero.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also, reduce the damage inflicted to allies under Protect by 10%. This is doubled for Avalon allies.

skills.name: Knight's Oath
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 2 times and increase this hero’s DEF and RES by 5% (Max 3 Stacks).

imprint_passive: When an ally receives a [Disable], there is a 20% chance this hero will receive it instead.
